أهرورق (form XII)
# أَهْرَوْرِقُ (ʔahrawriqu) /ʔah.raw.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
# أَهْرَوْرِقَ (ʔahrawriqa) /ʔah.raw.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
# أَهْرَوْرِقْ (ʔahrawriq) /ʔah.raw.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
